question: What characterizes a person who merely mocks the Kula scripture?
premises: Such a person is always fickle.
Such a person becomes a mockery of Kula scripture.
inference: A greedy and fickle seeker is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The gender agreement of capalā in this context is unclear.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
